images.title: The Four Gates at Blue Hour
images.description: A dark timber church, a low enclosing wall and offset gateways above a misty valley; pear trees, a well and warm windows establish a sheltered center.

images.title: Potters’ Terraces after Rain
images.description: Rain-darkened pottery terraces and three sheltered workshop bays recede toward an open river valley; clay vessels, timber, white plaster and warm lanterns carry the craft theme.

images.title: The Mill-Island Causeway
images.description: Three river islands hold two mills and a central home and granary; stone piers and timber crossings connect them across broad teal water, with a reed-lined boat and apples in front.

images.title: The Record Market before Opening
images.description: A golden brick rotunda encloses record stalls and arcade cabinets around a tree and circular listening bench. Foreground crates, worn parquet, plain discs and open passages suggest a shared market before opening.

images.title: The Last Train through the Console Hall
images.description: Concrete and red-painted columns divide a rain-darkened concourse into arcade repair, listening and waiting bays, with a cream-and-red local train beyond the right windows.

images.title: Three Studios at First Light
images.description: Three concrete river islands hold an open listening room, a glass rehearsal room and a modest antenna shed. Two friends carry a keyboard case across a repaired crossing; reeds, a boat and broad quiet water fill the foreground.
